Title: Hierarchical Reduced-Space Drift Detection Framework for Multivariate Supervised Data Streams
Takeaway: The HRDD framework effectively detects drifts in high-dimensional data streams, outperforming competitors in detection recall, precision, and F-measure across various concept drift types.
Authors: Shuyi Zhang, P. Tiňo, Xin Yao
Journal: IEEE Transactions on Knowledge and Data Engineering

Title: A Comprehensive Survey on Concept-Drift-Resilient Network Intrusion Detection Systems
Takeaway: Concept-drift-resilient network intrusion detection systems (NIDS) adapt to evolving networks, reducing operational instability and increasing vulnerability.
Authors: Mateus Komarchesqui, V. G. da Silva Ruffo, V. Schiavon, Matheus Riki Nakanishi, Gustavo Hideyuki Kitamura Nishikawa, L. F. Carvalho, M. Proença

Title: Cluster-specific localized drift detection for efficient batch model adaptation under controlled distribution shift
Takeaway: This study proposes a cluster-induced distribution shift simulation framework for evaluating six adaptation strategies in machine learning systems under controlled distribution shift conditions.
Authors: I. C. Martin, Marcello Trovati, Almas Baimagambetov, Nikolaos Polatidis

Title: METER: A Dynamic Concept Adaptation Framework for Online Anomaly Detection
Takeaway: METER, a dynamic concept adaptation framework for online anomaly detection, significantly outperforms existing approaches in handling concept drift in evolving data streams.
Authors: Jiaqi Zhu, Shao-Feng Cai, Fang Deng, Beng Chin Ooi, Wen-Qiao Zhang

Title: Continuous detection of concept drift in industrial cyber-physical systems using closed loop incremental machine learning
Takeaway: Our unsupervised machine learning algorithm effectively detects concept drift in industrial cyber-physical systems, improving prediction accuracy and robustness in applications like task tracking and smart energy consumption.
Authors: D. Jayaratne, Daswin de Silva, D. Alahakoon, Xing-Huo Yu

Title: Explanation audits reveal silent failures of machine learning models under distribution shift
Takeaway: Confidence-derived scores are effective for pointwise screening, while group-aware explanation audits provide complementary evidence about stable but incorrect feature reliance in machine learning models under distribution shift.
Authors: Faraz Masood, Sehba Masood, Arman Rasool Faridi, Andleeb Zoha, A. Khan, Ali Haider Shamsan

Title: From XAI to MLOps: Explainable concept drift detection with the partial dependence profiles-based approach
Takeaway: Profile Drift Detection (PDD) effectively detects and adapts to concept drift in predictive models, outperforming existing methods while maintaining high predictive performance in real-time applications.

Title: Concept drift detection in image data stream: a survey on current literature, limitations and future directions
Takeaway: This survey reviews concept drift detection methods for image data streams, categorizes them based on key properties, and highlights strengths and limitations, identifying promising future research directions.
Authors: Quang-Tien Tran, Nhien-An Le-Khac, Michela Bertolotto

Title: A Comprehensive Survey on Test-Time Adaptation Under Distribution Shifts
Takeaway: Test-time adaptation (TTA) improves machine learning performance by adapting pre-trained models to unlabeled data during testing, overcoming distribution shifts.
Authors: Jian Liang, R. He, Tien-Ping Tan

Title: Performance Drift Detection in Machine Learning as a Service (MLaaS) for IoT Environments
Takeaway: The proposed MLaaS Performance Drift Detection framework for IoT environments improves performance drift detection accuracy by up to 22-25% and reduces miss detection rates by 9% compared to fixed-interval monitoring.
Authors: Deepak Kanneganti, Sajib Mistry, S. Fattah, Erik Elmroth, Aneesh Krishna, Monowar Bhuyan
Journal: IEEE Transactions on Network and Service Management
